mechanism_narrative: The recent stabilization of WORKPLACES and TRANSIT after earlier declines signals commuting has stopped worsening, which should keep retail footfall from falling further and lift RETAIL_REC modestly over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT do not resume declines.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while WORKPLACES stay depressed, discretionary trips shift toward neighborhood shopping and errand bundling, pushing RETAIL_REC upward within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above 15 points while WORKPLACES stays below -45 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL remains above 15 and WORKPLACES remains below -45 for at least one week.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT begins to recover from deep negative levels, the access rebound to shopping districts will feed through to retail visits first, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 5 points from a prior week that was below -55
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve over 28 days after TRANSIT posts a weekly gain of at least 5 points from below -55.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GROCERY_PHARM from its recent trough indicates errand mobility is normalizing, and that spillover should spill into nearby retail and recreation visits over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM increases for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within 7 to 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM posts two consecutive weekly increases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PARKS and RESIDENTIAL indicates substitution toward local outdoor and home-based activity, which diverts discretionary time away from retail destinations and lowers RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall over the next 28 days while PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both remain above their prior-week levels.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS jumps sharply while TRANSIT remains weak, the mobility mix reflects substitution into local recreation rather than commercial trips, and RETAIL_REC will weaken within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 8 points week-on-week while TRANSIT stays below -50
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after PARKS jumps more than 8 points while TRANSIT remains below -50.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent gap where WORKPLACES stay far below baseline and RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline marks continued caution and limited shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC will remain lower over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying below -45 and RESIDENTIAL staying above 15.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES both improve together, the pattern reflects broader return of out-of-home routine activity that should pull RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises for two straight weeks and GROCERY_PHARM also rises in the same period
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or declines over 28 days after both GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES rise for two consecutive weeks.
